propositions: Bedrock inference-profile IDs must be invoked in AWS account 896586841071 region us-east-1 before corpus spend, with both bare and temperature=0 parameter probe calls to establish invokability per model slot.

The paired corpus run holds provider as the only variable by wrapping each arm in gate_config scope, runs 30 stratified gold-labeled cases (15 block, 15 advisory) across 15 eligible specs at N=3 epochs per arm per slot, and excludes agentic arms (completion-verifier, ticket-quality, spec-alignment) that bypass resolve_gate_config.

Payload parity and tool parity across providers must be proven by captured outbound requests at the provider boundary (same system prompt, messages, tools, max_tokens, temperature handling modulo provider-required envelope differences), not by code inspection alone.

Provider routing must be confirmed clean: the v2 Bedrock arm makes zero calls to non-Bedrock providers, verified from REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally with BOTH model field and non-null input_tokens present.

Every capability difference that legitimately alters the payload must be explicit and recorded (e.g., temperature withdrawal on opus driven by supports_temperature: False override), and no undocumented capability asymmetry must be discovered.

If any inference-profile ID is unmeasurable (ValidationException or AccessDeniedException on probe), that slot is recorded as unmeasured with exact refusal string rather than silently excluded, and the epic's first-class claim remains open for that slot.
